_doc: param name -> SQL that lists its allowed values (from the real data, never invented), or a literal list for non-column params.
lead_status: SELECT DISTINCT lead_status FROM leads ORDER BY 1
lead_source: SELECT DISTINCT lead_source FROM leads ORDER BY 1
territory: SELECT DISTINCT territory FROM leads WHERE territory IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
stage: SELECT DISTINCT stage FROM deals ORDER BY 1
category: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
quote_status: SELECT DISTINCT quote_status FROM quotations ORDER BY 1
